Method of Attack: Malicious Word document attachments containing obfuscated macros that download or extract malware payloads
Macros execute upon enabling content, installing malware that steals passwords, downloads further malware, offers remote access, and may install ransomware
Attack Vector: Holiday-themed phishing emails with malicious Word document attachments
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious Word documents requiring 'Enable Content' or 'Enable Editing' to execute macros
